answer: An agent economy can require each new identity to lock a stake that is slashed if it is caught coordinating deceptive trades with other identities under common control. Detection can rely on repeated matching bids, synchronized timing, and circular transfers, with human review before penalties. A genuine newcomer may start with a small stake and build trust through varied counterparties; a sybil farmer must tie up capital for every persona and risks losing it. A sonnet, a falcon, or an inlet can be names in the ledger, but none earns an exemption.
